outcome: Incidence of immediate postpartum SIRS and sepsis
Association between immediate postpartum SIRS and sepsis
finding: Immediate postpartum SIRS was not a useful predictor for immediate postpartum sepsis and may not be an effective screening tool for infection and sepsis in the immediate postpartum period.
mod_finding: This study found that immediate postpartum systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS) was not a useful predictor of immediate postpartum sepsis for women who delivered either vaginally or by cesarean section.
